-- Temporary dusk lighting for hawk visibility testing
-- Runs after a delay to override MetropolisLighting (ClockTime=0)
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local function setDusk()
	Lighting.ClockTime      = 18.5
	Lighting.Brightness     = 3
	Lighting.Ambient        = Color3.fromRGB(80, 60, 90)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 70)
	-- Remove midnight skybox so default dusk sky shows
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	if sky then sky:Destroy() end
	print("[LIGHTING] Dusk set — ClockTime 18.5")
end

-- Run immediately and again after 2s to beat MetropolisLighting
setDusk()
task.delay(2, setDusk)

-- Runs after a delay to override MetropolisLighting (ClockTime=0)
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local function setDusk()
	Lighting.ClockTime      = 18.5

	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 70)

	-- Remove midnight skybox so default dusk sky shows
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
	if sky then sky:Destroy() end
	print("[LIGHTING] Dusk set — ClockTime 18.5")
end

-- Run immediately and again after 2s to beat MetropolisLighting
setDusk()
task.delay(2, setDusk)
